name: winnxt-campaign-tools
description: Single-file HTML campaign tools for local candidates, sold on Etsy.

scripts.build: node build/inline.js --all && npm run quickstart && npm run etsy
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/pre-filing-check.test.js && node tests/crisis-triage.test.js && node tests/self-vet.test.js
scripts.quickstart: node build/inline.js src/quickstart/index.html dist/quickstart.html && node build/pdf.js dist/quickstart.html dist/quickstart.pdf
